rca of the issue: No blocking issue. Only non-blocking cosmetic: Recharts emits width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on BacktestPage equity chart initial mount (same root cause as iteration_11 AnalysisReportPage candlestick). Root cause: ResponsiveContainer mounts before its parent flex/grid card has computed its width, so first render fails the non-negative-dimensions check and Recharts logs twice per chart. Mitigation: set minWidth:1, minHeight:1 on the ResponsiveContainer wrapper (or <div style='width:100%; min-width:1px; height:320px'>), OR gate chart mount with a useEffect+layout effect until containerRef.current.clientWidth > 0.
